tooltipLines.leftText:
Equip: You gain Nalorakk's Favor of Enduring. Taking damage has a chance to grant a Mark of Frost, increasing your Critical Strike by 70 for 15 sec. Stacks up to 10 times.

If your health falls below 25%, the reservoir ruptures, consuming all marks to form a Frost Barrier that absorbs 48,227 damage per mark for 10 sec.

tooltipLines.leftText:
Equip: You gain Nalorakk's Favor of Growth. Your healing spells and abilities have a chance to instantly heal your target for 60,315 and spawn a glowing mushroom near them that lasts for 10 sec.

If an ally steps on and consumes the mushroom, they are healed for an additional 34,465.
"A draught from a species long lost everywhere but in dreams."
